transient_algorithm.fixed_loop_policy: Always24; independently certify terminal4 transitions; cap alone never proves convergence.
transient_algorithm.numerical_rationale: Single outer is PISO-like pressure correction with lagged thermo/momentum coupling, not coupled nonlinear convergence. psi=0 pressure cannot restore EOS mass. Fixed24 provides a finite budget; it is not a sufficiency claim.2 pressure correctors refresh pressure/U/phi each outer;0 nonorthogonal on inherited orthogonal mesh. No relaxation avoids changing governing matrix action and damping that can hide unconverged coupling. PCG suits registered symmetric pressure diffusion; PBiCGStab suits advective asymmetric U/e. Tight native solves are necessary but not nonlinear evidence. Cost up to24 momentum/energy,48 pressure and49 density solves per step; failure stops series without tuning.

courant_control.numerical_rationale: Fo=0.001 first physical step resolves initial wall-temperature jump and acceleration. Compare0.01/0.001/0.0001 against illustrative uniform2D highest heat eigenvalue bound8alpha/dx² and first Euler e^z/(1+z)-1. Choosemiddle below5e-5 illustrative local mode error without10x smaller startup cost. Not a CFD startup error proof. Fo<=1 cap is finite temporal-resolution policy, not explicit stability theorem. Existing steady speed suggests native Co caps later below maxDeltaT; prediction not guarantee. All Co series use SAMEcontrol deltaT and SAMEfirst physical step. Native initial preSolve+adjust increases input by1.2 even Co=0.

inner_convergence.certificate: All4 changes <=1e-7, each successive <=0.5 previous unless ALL4 <= fixed field arithmetic floor. Conservative tail proxy2*lastChange or4*floor must<=5e-5.
inner_convergence.roundoff_floor: Field F=64*DBL_EPSILON*(maxAbsState_k+maxAbsState_prev)/registered denominator. For Umax/Wmax use64*eps*(|Q_k|+|Q_prev|)/denom, covering2-cell interpolation and scaling; for Nu_bar_cavity add both evaluation bounds: (gamma_(N+8)*sum_i(abs((L/alpha0)*Ux_i*theta_i))/N+64*eps*(1+sum_i(abs((L/alpha0)*Ux_i)*(abs(T_i)+abs(Tc))/DeltaT)/N))/denom per iterate, N=25600. gamma_m=m*eps/(1-m*eps). Floor must<=1e-7; otherwise STOP_UNRESOLVABLE_OUTER_CERTIFICATE. These are stored-arithmetic allowances, not discretization/trajectory error bounds.
inner_convergence.budget_rationale: 5e-5 is100 times smaller than0.005 temporal target. Threshold1e-7=budget/500 with required contraction yields terminal tail proxy<=2e-7 and geometric extra margin. This is a conditional local fixed-point perturbation estimate, not a bound on global accumulated trajectory error or ill-conditioned/unobserved modes. Native residual normalization alone gives neither.
